description: This JavaScript file contains UI logic functions for a setup/configuration webpage in SuiteCRM. It manages form behaviors such as toggling visibility and enabling/disabling form elements based on user interactions during installation or database configuration.

methods.name: togglePasswordRetypeRequired()
methods.description: Toggles the display and state of the 'password retype' field based on whether the 'create sugarsales user' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: toggleDropTables()
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'drop tables' checkbox depending on the state of the 'create database' checkbox.

methods.name: toggleUsernameIsPrivileged()
methods.description: Shows or hides the privileged user info section based on the 'username is privileged' checkbox state.
